frontier.hypothesis: A byte-free generator OTHER than the s6 union yields two alter_reg slots and can be hosted by this function's own semantics.
frontier.mechanism: H-s8-3 proves the target needs exactly that: one slot from the Judge fold plus two from something emitting no instructions. The census so far covers Judge folds (site law), the HImode-bitwise generator (inert here), the truncated-division generator (not hostable - the function only divides by 32 and 2), and generator 4 (the union, Judge-FAILed).
frontier.next_probe: Run tmp/grind/func_80030580/s5/genprobe.py over a NEW standalone corpus aimed at register-allocated aggregates that are not unions - a small struct never address-taken, short/int bitfield structs, an enum-typed local, a struct whose only use is a member read - accepting only sp=0 hits with ctx=spill_new, then host the hits in-function with tmp/grind/func_80030580/s7/runfiles.py and require vars=24 bodydiff<=4 sp=0.

frontier.hypothesis: A 4-site Judge form exists whose two extra lookups are deleted by cse while their folded address pseudos still orphan, reaching vars=24 at bodydiff<=4.
frontier.mechanism: j4read already reaches the exact target frame (p110/p130/p143) at bodydiff=25, and s5 itemises the surplus as exactly the two extra lookups (lh angle / addu const / andi 0xFFF / sll 1 / lh Judge / addu, twice). The open question - never measured - is whether cse deleting a redundant Judge LOAD also deletes the address pseudo that combine would otherwise fold and orphan.
frontier.next_probe: Spell the two extra Judge reads with index expressions provably equal to the existing two (so cse merges the loads) and measure vars/bodydiff with tmp/grind/func_80030580/s7/runfiles.py; if the pseudo survives cse the form is byte-neutral and closes the function with no new construct family.

frontier.hypothesis: If frontier items 1 and 2 also measure dead, the sanctioned ladder for func_80030580 is genuinely spent.
frontier.mechanism: Both known routes to vars=24 are closed by standing Judge constraints (the volatile u32 pre_pad[4] phantom-pad and the generator-4 union), the solver axis is closed by tool verdict (H-s8-1), and the permuter axis was closed at 84k iterations in s4.
frontier.next_probe: Do NOT dispose of the function from a non-escalation modality. Work items 1 and 2 first; only an escalation-modality session should assemble the foreclosure record, and it now has the full evidence chain (site law + byte-free-generator requirement + the two Judge FAILs) to do so.

judge_constraints: Restore memory/grind/func_80030580/pure-c-floor2-body.c as the chassis; the only frozen route to the target's 24 untouched locals bytes is the Phantom-frame-slot volatile pad local family in its exact sanctioned form (volatile u32 pad[N], first-decl position, // !FAKE annotation, engine allowlist row, frame forensics per .claude/rules/phantom-slot-frame-lever.md) -- measure it, do not respell the aggregate carrier.
